name: Shiprocket
shortInfo: A shipping and logistics platform primarily used for streamlining the order fulfillment process.
brief: Shiprocket is **a shipping and logistics platform primarily used by e-commerce businesses in India, streamlining their order fulfillment process**. It integrates with various online store platforms, allowing businesses to manage orders, print shipping labels, and track shipments.
about:
Shiprocket is an online shipping platform that connects online retailers to multiple courier partners for shipping their products to their customers.

Shiprocket Connector enables streaming relevant Shiprocket data into a user determined data warehouse. This sync happens in an automated manner after a user has configured relevant pipelines and determined an update frequency.
availableData:
[Orders](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/shiprocket/pipelines/orders.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve a list of all created and available orders in your Shiprocket account.

[Order Details](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/shiprocket/pipelines/order-details.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve the order details from the Shiprocket platform.

[Shipments](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/shiprocket/pipelines/shipments.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve the shipments from the Shiprocket platform.
